basics.name: Daniel Gause
basics.label: Postbaccalaureate Researcher, National Radio Astronomy Observatory
basics.summary: Postbaccalaureate researcher at the National Radio Astronomy Observatory studying protostellar outflows, and preparing to apply to astronomy PhD programs.

courses: Physics thesis: Structural Analysis of Potential Dual Quasar Pairs
Mathematics thesis: An Introduction to Large Deviation Theory

work.name: National Radio Astronomy Observatory
highlights: Compiling lists of nearby (<500 pc) Class 0/I protostars and Herbig–Haro objects from published catalogs
Building a tested Python pipeline that harvests ALMA, MAST, NOIRLab, and other archive holdings and tags spectral-line coverage per target
Identifying targets with multi-epoch observations suited to jet kinematics and proper motions

work.name: NSF-Simons AI Institute for Cosmic Origins (CosmicAI), National Radio Astronomy Observatory
highlights: Built MANNA, an open-source MCP server that lets AI assistants query astronomical data archives via IVOA standards; released on PyPI and the MCP Registry
Assessed MCP performance across multiple LLMs with a custom evaluation framework; with MANNA, models ran up to 8.1× faster at up to 6.7× lower cost
Deployed open-weight LLMs on NOIRLab Astro Data Lab GPUs and integrated the Astro Data Lab JupyterHub with jupyter-ai

work.name: University of California Observatories, Lick Observatory
highlights: Lead developer of STIPS, adapting the LSST Science Pipelines to the Nickel and CTIO 1-m telescopes
Calibrated Landolt standards to ≤12 mmag in BVRI; astrometry matches Gaia DR3 to 14–48 mas
Reproduced published photometry of SNe 2023ixf and 2020wnt and recovered the HD 189733 b transit

work.name: City College of San Francisco
highlights: Observed cataclysmic variables, including AY Psc, in BVRI on the Lick 1-m Nickel Telescope
Wrote a Python reduction pipeline: bias, flat-field, astrometric, and photometric calibration

work.name: Accenture Federal Services
highlights: Led development for two small teams building production GenAI services, including a FastAPI backend with Azure OpenAI and vector search
Built over a dozen Python packages with unit, integration, and functional tests and CI/CD

work.name: Accenture Federal Services
highlights: Trained survival models on >10M UNOS records (Apache Spark) to predict kidney-waitlist outcomes
Built ML models on NASA satellite imagery to predict wildfire, flood, and landslide risk

work.name: Department of Physics, Middlebury College
highlights: Cross-matched >1M known quasars with archival HST imaging; built a pipeline to reduce MAST data
Ran surface-brightness contour analysis on thousands of images, identifying 21 dual-quasar candidates
